selected.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: transparent layered 2D tactical SD character rig texture atlas, for a smooth continuously animated idle cycle.
Input image 1 is the existing original character's front/back/right appearance reference. Preserve this exact original character identity, outfit, colors, face, weapon, and SD proportions. male ash-brown hair with cobalt underhair, blue-gray eyes, charcoal short jacket, ivory high-neck shirt, cobalt LEFT shoulder drape, straight lowered sword in RIGHT hand. No long rear hair; column4 contains ONLY the cobalt shoulder drape. Polished clean anime tactical SD rendering, simple readable shapes.

Create ONE exact 4-column by 3-row atlas on an actually transparent background; all 12 cells are equal squares, total aspect ratio 4:3, no text, no grid lines. Row 1 = front, Row 2 = back, Row 3 = facing right. This is NOT 4 animation poses: the columns are 4 different separated DRAWABLE BODY LAYERS of one identical resting combat pose in that row.

CRITICAL REGISTRATION: Each cell is the SAME full-body coordinate space. Parts must stay where they belong in the assembled full character. Never enlarge or center isolated heads or legs within a cell. If the four cells in any row are overlaid, they must seamlessly reconstruct one complete character.
In each square cell, full assembled character would span x 18%-82%, y 12%-88%; feet at y88%, pelvis at y72%, shoulders at y49%, head top at y12%, chin near y49%. Keep pose/scale/perspective exactly identical between parts in each row.

Column 1 = LOWER BODY ONLY: waist/pelvis, tunic belt, short lower tunic/skirt, both complete legs and boots; upper edge hidden at waist with generous overlap under torso. No head, no arms, no weapon, no long cape, no ponytail.
Column 2 = TORSO + ARMS + EQUIPMENT ONLY: torso, shoulders, short mantle collar, both complete arms and hands, correctly held character's original held equipment. No head, no hair, no legs, no long hanging cape panels. Reconstruct a fully closed neck/shoulder and waist area to overlap other parts, no holes.
Column 3 = HEAD ONLY: entire intact head, face or back of head as appropriate, ears, the compact hair cap and front fringe with hair clip. Exclude any long trailing rear hair, which belong to column4. Keep the head full size at its normal upper-body position. Back view must show the full intact back hair cap.
Column 4 = LOOSE REAR HAIR + CAPE ONLY: the loose rear cloth/scarf tails and any long rear hair specified for this character, complete behind the body, positioned where they would be in the full character. No face, no torso, no arms, no boots, no weapon. Keep all attachment roots well filled so later gentle movement cannot expose gaps.

All parts are clean painted cutout layers with hidden joint overlap 10-15 source pixels. Rendering order: column4 behind, column1 lower body, column2 torso, column3 head on top. No duplicate silhouettes or full-body ghosts in the individual cells. Orthographic view, consistent soft lighting, no shadows on background, no checkerboard, no white matte, no particles, no glow, no red fringe, no labels.
ADDITIONAL CHARACTER-SPECIFIC LAYER RULE: male ash-brown hair with cobalt underhair, blue-gray eyes, charcoal short jacket, ivory high-neck shirt, cobalt LEFT shoulder drape, straight lowered sword in RIGHT hand. No long rear hair; column4 contains ONLY the cobalt shoulder drape.
The back view column4 must NOT contain the full head/hair cap: only loose trailing pieces, because the head is already column3.
